_status: MERGED 2026-10-08 into benchmarks.json v1.14.0 with source_article https://insiderllm.com/guides/qwen-3-8-35b-a3b-distill-vs-qwen-3-6-35b/. This file keeps the rows as staged (source_article null).

hardware.system_ram_detail: 2 x 16 GB G.Skill F4-3200C16-16GVK, dual rank, 2 of 4 slots (31 GiB visible). Corrected 2026-10-05: runs at DDR4-2133 (memory profile not active; a 2026-10-05 attempt to enable it failed training). Resident-model results are unaffected. dmidecode reads Configured Memory Speed 2133 MT/s. Recorded as DDR4-3200 per the builder until v1.12.0. Sustained read 32.36 GB/s (stream_read.c, docs/bench-results/tamanna-docp-verify-2026-10-05), not comparable to the 2026-07-30 Miu/rushuna STREAM figures
hardware.pcie: 4.0 x16 (gen 4 in every under-load telemetry sample)

model.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
model.quant_source: unknown (store file, no download or quantize record; no imatrix keys)
model.sha256_note: Store copy LLM_repo/qwen3.6-35b-a3b-gguf/qwen3.6-35b-a3b-Q4_K_M.gguf, dated 2026-07-21 beside our F16; probably quantized locally from it, not confirmed. The hash is of the file as found.

provenance.run_order: block 3 priming: three reps, the two models alternating within a rep with the starting model flipped on rep 2, and a discarded priming run of the identical command before every measured run

run_slots.slot: rep 1 (measured, after a discarded priming run)
rep 2 (measured, after a discarded priming run)
rep 3 (measured, after a discarded priming run)

provenance.methodology_note: Pinned build v0.4.0. generation_tok_s_stddev is the mean of llama-bench's per-run stddev; the repeat spread is max minus min of the three measured reps. Peak VRAM is the nvidia-smi maximum at 1 s across each run. Power is the mean board draw over samples at 50 percent utilisation or more. Memory watchdog memwatch.py --count-swap ran throughout; no trip; swap counters in the record.

rows.notes: Control for the distill comparison. Plain Q4_K_M of unknown provenance (hash recorded, not verified against any source). 23/47 on the 47-item intent split, thinking off, v0.4.0.
